crc_repair: CRC-32/ISO-HDLC; inner QST1 CRC is repaired before outer CRC when requested

vectors.name: outer-crc-mismatch
vectors.mutation: xor first outer CRC byte with 0x80

vectors.name: reserved-codec-bit
vectors.mutation: set outer header byte 15 to 0x84; repair outer CRC

vectors.name: zero-width
vectors.mutation: set outer width to zero; repair outer CRC

vectors.name: invalid-outer-mode
vectors.mutation: set outer mode to 255; repair outer CRC

vectors.name: illegal-native-transform
vectors.mutation: set outer native transform to 1; repair outer CRC

vectors.name: stored-payload-size-mismatch
vectors.mutation: set declared outer payload size to 42; repair outer CRC

vectors.name: qst-magic
vectors.mutation: replace QST1 byte zero with X; repair outer CRC

vectors.name: qst-invalid-mode
vectors.mutation: set QST1 native mode to 55; repair QST1 and outer CRCs

vectors.name: qst-invalid-tile-log
vectors.mutation: set QST1 tile log2 to 8; repair QST1 and outer CRCs

vectors.name: qst-payload-size-mismatch
vectors.mutation: set QST1 payload size to 12; repair QST1 and outer CRCs

vectors.name: qst-container-crc
vectors.mutation: xor first QST1 container CRC byte; repair outer CRC only

vectors.name: qst-pixel-crc
vectors.mutation: xor first decoded-pixel CRC byte; repair QST1 and outer CRCs

vectors.name: trailing-stored-byte
vectors.mutation: insert 0xa5 before outer footer; repair outer CRC
